posts.author: Skyla
posts.body:
Greetings everyone; my name is Skyla and... I honestly forgot I made this account for awhile there.  I'm a long time RPG Maker user (back to ye olden days of RPG Maker 95), and I'm just starting to get into the scene again with RPG Maker MZ.  Right now I'm working on a Sailor Moon fan game that's in early development.
I admit, I signed up (or re-signed in rather) mostly because I need help finding a plugin.  If all goes well, though, I might settle in and put up a progress post for my game as well.
